audit.scope: raw collected files in C:/Users/Mohammed856/finengine-raw-odd (read-only); no network, no data/**, no AWS/Supabase
audit.method: SHA-256 recomputed per audited file (tools/expand_sha.py). The FY2023 statements are image-only pages and were rendered and read; the FY2025, FY2024, H1 2026 and Q1 2026 files are born digital and were read from the text layer with page renders of the FY2025 income statement and the H1 2026 balance sheet as visual checks. tools/check_transcripts.py over transcripts/8200.json: BS identity, cash-flow sum and roll, cross-filing agreement with explicit restated flags, Q1+Q2=H1 (exact); all pass. UNIT: all values are in FULL SAR (not thousands).

value_correctness.summary: Headline values (full SAR; revenue = reinsurance revenue) transcribed for FY2023, FY2024, FY2025, Q1 2026 and H1 2026 with their comparatives (FY2022 restated, 2023 re-presented, 2024, Q1/H1 2025). Identities hold: assets = liabilities + equity (all columns where both were read), CFO+CFI+CFF = net change and begin + net = end (no FX line), Q1+Q2=H1 exact for revenue and net income in 2025 and 2026. Selected: FY2025 reinsurance revenue 1,672,498,610, net income after zakat and tax 140,044,427, CFO 259,418,235, total assets 4,636,714,715, equity 2,191,617,352; H1 2026 revenue 1,261,599,875, net income 161,560,094, total assets 4,886,977,476. Unit trap: the interim files are also full SAR, so no annual-versus-interim scale difference exists in this company. BS cash and cash-flow end cash differ in FY2023 (87,905,002 versus 83,979,142) and FY2024 (73,464,920 versus 66,733,051), in FY2025 they agree; cash flow cash is a narrower definition and both values are recorded.

defects.evidence: Standalone annual FS files 3d9e38b9, ec3db097, 55d9a6c3, b505c414 cover FY2022, FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 and are labelled 2023|FY, 2024|FY, 2025|FY, 2026|FY (cover pages and statement headers). Inventory marks 2026|FY as complete although 2026 has not ended.
ec3db097: pdf pages 3-12 have no text layer and hold the auditor's report and all primary statements; the inventory classes the file annual_report_with_statements and places it in 2024|FY.

(a) FY2023 total assets 2,689,947,151 and total liabilities 1,543,125,112 as filed in ec3db097, versus 2,581,631,309 and 1,434,809,270 in the 2023 column of the FY2024 filing (asterisk re-presentation); equity 1,146,822,039, net income 124,429,494, CFO -5,887,684 identical. (b) 31 Dec 2025 balance sheet: FY2025 filing total assets 4,636,714,715, liabilities 2,445,097,363 (retrocession contract assets 907,624,519, reinsurance contract liabilities 2,189,517,956, accrued expenses 61,165,574) versus 4,634,143,941, 2,442,526,589 (905,053,745, 2,210,409,133, 37,703,623) in the H1 2026 filing; the Q1 2026 filing still shows the FY2025 figures. Equity unchanged. (c) FY2024 EPS 5.33 as filed versus 3.69 restated in the FY2025 filing; H1/Q1 2025 EPS also restated (rights issue bonus element). (d) FY2022 comparatives restated at IFRS 17 transition (2022 revenue 696,997,918, net income 76,052,381 in the FY2023 filing); the originally filed FY2022 statements 3d9e38b9 were not read, so the pre-restatement values are not recorded here. Both versions of every item above are in transcripts/8200.json with restated flags.

BS cash and bank balances differ from cash-flow cash and cash equivalents for 2023 (87,905,002 vs 83,979,142) and 2024 (73,464,920 vs 66,733,051). Consumers must not assert BS cash = cash-flow end cash for this issuer; the note explaining the difference was not read.

conclusion: NOT claimed complete. Five filings verified for headline values; most of the 110 files, in particular all pre-2022 files and the 2022 to 2025 interims, are unread; two significant re-presentations recorded.
